archiveBoundary: Archive embeds are cross-origin. A successful no-cors preflight confirms a connection but cannot inspect the HTML/status of an opaque response, and WebThen cannot read later internal navigation URLs or browser-generated error documents reliably. Initial network rejection and timeout are masked with the period screen, but a later iframe redirect/navigation can fail after the connection check. Meeting an unconditional never guarantee would require a cooperative archive signal or a separately designed replay/proxy system. This release does not weaken browser security, proxy third-party scripts into WebThen’s origin, or disable working embedding to pretend the guarantee is complete.
